subject: Onboarding: PO requirement & invoicing path for pilot
messages:
From: Tom Reynolds <tom@fastcompute.io>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Cc: accounts@fastcompute.io
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 09:42:00 -0700
Subject: Onboarding: PO requirement & short-term invoice path for pilot

Hi Markus,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — excited to get FastCompute hooked into Redwood for the pilot. Accounting here and I want to confirm the vendor onboarding steps so we can invoice promptly. A few specific questions: 

- Do you require a Redwood PO for the initial pilot invoices? Our standard practice is invoice-only for small pilots (monthly invoices, Net 30).
- If a PO is required, what is the earliest we can get a PO generated? If not, what exception process do we follow?
- What onboarding documents do you need from our side? I’ve attached our W-9 — let me know if you need additional tax or contract paperwork.

We expect the first month to be low-dollar (estimated $1,800). If usage ramps, we’ll need to know the trigger to switch to PO-based billing so we don’t miss a cycle.

Attached: FastCompute_W9.pdf (PDF, 94 KB)

Appreciate any quick guidance so we can close our internal loop.

Best,
Tom Reynolds
Head of Finance, FastCompute, Inc.
Tom.Reynolds@fastcompute.io | +1 415-555-0147

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Tom Reynolds <tom@fastcompute.io>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 13:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding: PO requirement & short-term invoice path for pilot

Tom — thanks for the W-9 and for the clear summary. Quick answers up front:

- Default policy: Redwood issues POs for ongoing engagements and any single-invoice amount >= $5,000.
- For small pilots (sub-$3k per invoice) we can approve a temporary invoice-only path via a procurement exception that expires after 90 days. That requires a short onboarding checklist and finance sign-off.
- If usage scales above the threshold we’ll request a PO; we can also retroactively generate a PO for the contract period but it requires approvals and may delay payment processing.

Next steps I’ll take from here: loop in procurement (GRACE) and finance (LOGAN) to start the exception form and confirm Net 30 terms. Grace — can you share the onboarding checklist and the Invoice-Only Trial (IOT) form with Tom and accounts? Logan — please flag any billing or AP constraints.

Tom — link to our vendor onboarding form (fillable): https://redwood.example.com/vendor-intake (please fill company registration, remittance address, and ACH details if available).

I’ll keep this thread as the central record.

Thanks,
Markus Klein
Head of Strategic Partnerships | Redwood Inference
markus_klein@redwood.com

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Tom Reynolds <tom@fastcompute.io>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 13 Aug 2026 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding: PO requirement & short-term invoice path for pilot

Tom — welcome, and thanks for sending the W-9. I’m procurement and I’ll own the exception workflow for the pilot. Please find the short checklist attached (FastCompute_Onboarding_Form.xlsx). Overview below: 

Checklist (high level):
- Completed onboarding form (attached spreadsheet) — company registration + tax details
- W-9 (received)
- Primary contact and billing email (we have Tom.Reynolds@fastcompute.io)
- Proof of incorporation (PDF) or equivalent (scanned)
- Confirmation of payment terms: Net 30 is fine for pilot invoices

Temporary invoice-only concession:
- Cap: $3,000 per invoice (pilot window)
- Duration: 90 days from approval date
- Accounting will process payment without a PO within the cap; any invoice >$3,000 will be held pending PO creation/approval.
- We will track the exception in Procurement (REQ-98742) and notify you if a PO is required earlier.

Attachments: FastCompute_Onboarding_Form.xlsx (spreadsheet, 28 KB) — please complete tabs "Company Info" and "Banking" and return.

A few process notes for your AP team: 
- Send invoices to: ap-invoices@redwood.com with the subject line: FastCompute — Invoice — [Month]
- Include the invoice PDF and remittance instructions.

Once you return the completed form I’ll route for finance sign-off (Logan) and then final approval. If that’s all OK I’ll start the 90-day exception and send confirmation with the REQ number.

Thanks,
Grace O'Connor
Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwood.com

From: Tom Reynolds <tom@fastcompute.io>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>, accounts@fastcompute.io
Date: Thu, 13 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding: PO requirement & short-term invoice path for pilot

Grace — thanks, that all looks clear. I completed the attached onboarding form and filled the Company Info + Banking tabs; returning it here as requested. A few clarifications inline: 

- We confirm Net 30 and will send invoices to ap-invoices@redwood.com.
- Our estimated first invoice is ~$1,800 for the trial month; we’ll flag you immediately if usage looks like it will exceed the $3,000 cap.
- If a PO is required retroactively, please advise the lead time — we’ll plan internal approvals on our side but would prefer not to have payments held.

(Attachment: FastCompute_Onboarding_Form.xlsx — completed)

Let me know if you need a company incorporation scan or anything else; happy to share. Looking forward to starting.

Best,
Tom

From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Reynolds <tom@fastcompute.io>
Date: Fri, 14 Aug 2026 16:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding: PO requirement & short-term invoice path for pilot

Thanks for the details, team. Quick finance note:

- Net 30 is fine. We’ll accept invoice-only for this pilot under the parameters Grace outlined.
- Please ensure invoices include an itemized usage summary and the invoice number to avoid processing delays.
- If we see sustained monthly spend >$3,000 for two consecutive months we’ll trigger a PO requirement and reach out to FastCompute to coordinate PO issuance — we will not retroactively hold already-submitted invoices within the approved period, but starting the month after the trigger we’ll require a PO for new invoices.

Grace — you can mark REQ-98742 as Approved by Finance. Tom — once we receive the completed form we’ll confirm the exception start date and send the formal approval note.

Logan Wright
Senior Manager, Finance Operations | Redwood Inference
logan_wright@redwood.com
